services.name: Las Vegas Helicopter Tour
services.desc: Choose the ultimate Las Vegas ATV adventure tour and Grand Canyon helicopter flight. Begin your day with all-inclusive transfers to the Las Vegas Terminal in a Mercedes Benz Sprinter passenger vehicles. Following a brief check-in your friendly Pilot will escort you to your waiting jet helicopter before you enjoy some of the most stunning scenery in the world. With your Pilot narrating the entire experience you will see amazing views of Hoover Dam, Bypass Bridge and the extinct volcano - Fortification Hill, before the wonders of the Grand Canyon open up before you, as you fly above and below the rim of the Canyon itself. Colorado River Kayak Tours offers multiple launch times throughout the year, giving guests flexibility when planning their Las Vegas outdoor adventure.
